401873083.summary: Analysts lean Denver straight up but split on the spread. The Broncos (8-2, six straight wins, 8-2 ATS) beat the Raiders 38-24 on Sunday, while the Steelers (6-4, 4-0 at home) turn to Mason Rudolph after Aaron Rodgers was benched. Sports Betting Dime backs Denver -4.5, citing its red-zone TD rate (67.7% vs 42.9%), and ATS.io says Denver's pass rush (31 sacks, 4th in blitz rate) will trouble Pittsburgh. The contrarian case comes from SI Betting and CBS Sports: Pittsburgh is far better at home and leads the league in rush EPA against a Denver run defense that ranks 26th; CBS picks the Steelers 23-20. ESPN's matchup predictor also leans Pittsburgh (51.9%) despite a -229 market. Rain and wind are expected, and Steelers pass rushers Herbig and Highsmith carry injury tags.
